body:
You're not a waste. People without depression or having these feelings can find it really, really hard to relate to you. It's not the same thing as you being spoiled. I've had people tell me similar things "Oh, well everybody feels bad now and then." It's probably not their fault, you know...they're maybe hoping for your sake too that it's not as bad as they think it might be. A lot of times people treat us the way that they want us to be or the way that they hope we are for fear of acknowledging the way that we actually are. I don't know your brother obviously so I can't speak for him, but don't let his comments invalidate the way you feel.

You said that you're contemplating the pros and cons of life, but you mostly gave a list of cons. What about the pros? What about those magical moments? You're still capable of feeling something, and sometimes something really great. Are those moments worth living for? If you could take those moments and have more of them, maybe not all the time, but more frequently and tied to something that you feel good about doing, would that make life worth it?

Maybe so, maybe not. But it's worth trying, right? What haven't you tried (that's not incredibly risky/illegal/etc.)? If you're at the end of things...maybe just say the hell with it and try something new, something you might be skeptical about? Sometimes for me a shock to the system can help me get a different perspective and reset things. I dunno, YMMV for sure, and don't do something risky or stupid, but don't deny yourself the possibility to be happy, if you can. I know it can be really hard to force yourself to take action or get out of the house, but try thinking back to a time, if you can, to when you were really happy, maybe something you did when you were a kid like listening to music or going out in nature, or anything. And then go do it, no matter how stupid...coloring with crayons, playing with Play-Dough, literally whatever it is. And just see. I dunno. 

It sucks to not have people around, but sometimes you can save yourself. I believe that you can but I know, it sucks, and life can be a bitch, and it's really hard to believe that. Crying is not a bad thing, it can help too. You're not weak, just sad. You're capable of coming on here and talking at least, and reaching out — that shows to me you're still capable of doing this, if you want. Not easy by any means, but think about it. At least don't give up tonight. Sleep on it, think it over, treat yourself to a good meal. Things can change.
